Settings

Appearance, your reviewer identity, autosave and proofing. Everything here is stored in this browser.

Theme
Language

Translations other than English are machine-produced and have not been reviewed by a native speaker.

Accent
Reviewer identity

Attributed on comments and tracked changes you create. This is the only identity source — the engine never invents an author.

Autosave

Drafts stay in this browser, on this device, for up to 24 hours. They are never uploaded, and are deleted as soon as you save.

Spelling

Checking happens in this browser: the dictionary is downloaded once from this site and your text is never sent anywhere. Words you add are stored in this browser only, and can currently be removed only by clearing this site's data.

Name this version

A named version is kept until you delete it, and can be found by name.

Naming a version changes nothing in the document — only how this version is listed and how long it is kept.

Two versions may share a name; they are told apart by time.
